description: Get live valuation metrics for any US-listed company (not just IPOs), computed from primary sources: SEC XBRL companyfacts TTM fundamentals (revenue, net income, EBITDA, debt, cash, shares) plus the latest market close. Returns multiples (P/E, P/S, EV/Revenue, EV/EBITDA), derivations (PEG, earnings/sales/EBITDA yields, net-debt/EBITDA), margins, and YoY growth — the same data IPOSignal's valuation pipeline uses for peer benchmarking, with the computation convention stated in the response. Provide exactly one of symbol (any SEC-mapped ticker) or companyName (resolves Nasdaq/NYSE listings). PREMIUM: paid per call over x402 (USDC on Base); an unpaid call returns the payment terms, and a not-found is never charged. Same data and price as the HTTP endpoint /api/agent/company-metrics.

companyName.description: Company name, used when the ticker is unknown. Resolves Nasdaq/NYSE listings only.

symbol.description: Any SEC-mapped US ticker, e.g. AAPL. Provide exactly one of symbol or companyName.

name: get_company_metrics

cash.description: Cash and cash equivalents at the latest balance sheet, USD.

ebitda.description: Operating income + depreciation and amortization, USD.

freeCashFlow.description: Operating cash flow − capital expenditures, USD.

netIncome.description: Net income, USD. Negative for a loss.

sharesOutstanding.description: Shares outstanding used for marketCap. See sharesSource for which count it is.

accession.description: Accession number of the filing the count was read from.

asOf.description: Date the count is as of, YYYY-MM-DD.

classCount.description: cover-per-class only: how many share classes were summed.

method.description: dei-total (the total on a 10-K or 10-Q cover), cover-per-class (the sum of the share classes on the cover) or weighted-average-basic (the EPS denominator, used only when no cover count exists).

totalDebt.description: Debt at the latest balance sheet, USD: the combined debt figure when filed, else long-term debt + its current portion + short-term borrowings.

fundamentalsTtm.description: Trailing-twelve-month figures from SEC XBRL company facts, USD: the last full year + this year to date − last year to date.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key as a number, without leading zeros, e.g. 1876042.

exchange.description: Listing exchange: NASDAQ, NYSE, NYSEAMER (NYSE American) or OTC. Other venues verbatim.

name.description: Registrant name as filed with the SEC, e.g. Circle Internet Group, Inc.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol the company trades under now, upper case, e.g. CRCL.

listing.description: The company the query resolved to.

priceClose.description: Latest daily closing price, USD per share.

netIncomeGrowthPct.description: Net income in the latest fiscal year against the year before. Null when the earlier year is zero or negative.

operatingIncomeGrowthPct.description: Operating income in the latest fiscal year against the year before. Null when the earlier year is zero or negative.

revenueGrowthPct.description: Revenue in the latest fiscal year against the year before. Null when the earlier year is zero or negative.

profile.description: Margins over the trailing twelve months and growth over the last fiscal year, percent.

convention.description: How EBITDA, enterprise value and PEG are defined.

shares.description: Which share count was used, from which filing, and what it assumes.

sources.description: Where each input came from, in words.

reason.description: no-price (no recent close), no-share-count (no share count filed yet) or no-sec-facts (SEC company facts unreadable).

unavailable.description: Present instead of the figures when the company resolved but no market cap can be struck.

enterpriseValue.description: marketCap + totalDebt − cash, USD. A missing debt or cash figure counts as 0; null when both are missing.

evEbitda.description: enterpriseValue ÷ TTM EBITDA. Null when EBITDA is zero or negative.

freeCashFlowEvYieldPct.description: TTM free cash flow ÷ enterpriseValue, percent. Negative for a company burning cash.

netDebtToEbitda.description: (totalDebt − cash) ÷ TTM EBITDA. Negative when cash exceeds debt.

peRatio.description: Price to earnings: marketCap ÷ TTM net income. Null when net income is zero or negative.

pegRatio.description: peRatio ÷ netIncomeGrowthPct. Null unless both are positive.

valuation.description: Multiples at priceClose. A multiple is null when its denominator is missing or not positive.

title: Live company valuation metrics (premium)
